spec.name: Tamuda Festival
spec.description: Summer concert festival held on Plage Rifiyine in Fnideq, bringing Moroccan and international artists to the beachfront over multiple nights.

recurrence.note: Only one edition (2026) has been confirmed via ticketing platforms; whether this is a long-running annual event or a newly launched concert series could not be verified from fetched sources - flagged for follow-up.

editions.notes: Multiple concert dates at Plage Rifiyine, Fnideq, including RIM'K, Khaled, and Gims & Draganov; edition number not confirmed
